content: सभा [सह भान्ति अभीष्टनिश्चयार्थमेकत्र यत्र गृहे <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 An assembly, a council, conclave; पण्डितसभां कारितवान् <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; न सा सभा यत्र न सन्ति वृद्धाः <ls>H. 1</ls>. .²2 Company, society, meeting, large number. .²3 Council-chamber or hall; ततः सभां करिष्यामि पाण्डवस्य यशस्विनीम् <ls>Mb. 2. 3. 4</ls>, <ls n="Mb.">12. 47. 7</ls>. .²4 A court of justice. .²5 A public audience (modern {%levee%}). .²6 A gambling-house. .²7 Any room or place much frequented. .²8 A house for lodging travellers (धर्मशाला). .²9 An eating house.
